definitions.gloss: board surface; board position; state of the board
definitions.explanation: The surface of a game board (such as shogi, go, or chess), or the current arrangement of pieces on it.

examples.japanese: {盤面|ばんめん}をよく{見|み}てから{打|う}て。
examples.english: Look carefully at the board before making your move.

examples.japanese: {盤面|ばんめん}が{複雑|ふくざつ}になってきた。
examples.english: The board position has become complicated.

examples.japanese: {解説者|かいせつしゃ}が{盤面|ばんめん}を{見|み}ながら{次|つぎ}の{一手|いって}を{予想|よそう}した。
examples.english: The commentator predicted the next move while looking at the board position.

notes:
Refers to both the physical surface of a game board and the current state of play on it. Most commonly used in the context of {将棋|しょうぎ} (shogi), {囲碁|いご} (go), and チェス (chess). Also used in board game and video game contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盤面|ばんめん}を{見|み}る: to look at the board
- {盤面|ばんめん}が{動|うご}く: the board position changes
- {盤面|ばんめん}を{読|よ}む: to read the board position
- {盤面|ばんめん}{全体|ぜんたい}: the entire board

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {局面|きょくめん}: phase, situation — used in games and more broadly for situations
- {盤|ばん}: board — the physical board itself ({将棋盤|しょうぎばん}, {碁盤|ごばん})
- {棋譜|きふ}: game record — the written record of moves played
